rv.q: This production still offers a formidable musical experience, coming at you with more emotional intensity and existential gravitas than any other time I've seen this particular show.
When the ensemble lets loose on “In Every Age,” the show’s opening number, the sound is majestic and expansive, and it carries that power throughout.
This show is so superior and sublime, I’d gladly pay to see it again.
Marriott’s “Titanic The Musical” becomes a stunning musical odyssey.

By eschewing bombast and melodrama to focus on subtler, achingly poignant moments like these, this Titanic helps us feel the loss of not just a great ship, but of all these individual lives exactly 113 years later.

From the stirring opening chorus to the various solo and duet pieces that characterize the dreams and hopes of the passengers of all classes, we feel intimately involved with each of them thanks to a sterling cast.

It’s an exhilarating piece of music, as evidenced on opening night of Marriott Theatre’s magnificent, robustly sung revival when 21 singer/actors and conductor Brad Haak’s sextet nearly stopped the show.
You will find a lovely dinner followed by a truly immersive night to remember as you meet some of the people who lived, and who didn’t, on that calm Atlantic evening over 113 years ago.
The artistic team has created a monumental, powerful, 'WOW' production that I believe was both evocative, heart-wrenching, and, at times, humorous.
This production, directed and choreographed by Conner Gallagher on the in-the-round stage at Marriott Lincolnshire is a triumph in bringing story to stage.
The Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire, IL more than does justice to the story line with its beautiful music by Maury Yeston and perfect book by Peter Stone.
The musical itself and the company at Marriott handle the gravity of the subject matter with a sensitive hand.

cn.t: Critics praise Marriott Theatre's stunning production of "Titanic The Musical" for its sweeping, beautiful score, emotionally moving performances, and majestic staging that brings the passengers' stories to life with breathtaking power.
